function.name: shell
function.arguments:
{"command": "cd "$(pwd)"
echo "=== service.txt exact contents ==="
cat service.txt; echo
printf 'expected: '; printf '%s' 'p6-service-ok' | sha256sum
printf 'actual:   '; sha256sum service.txt
python3 - <<'PY'
data = open("service.txt", "rb").read()
print("equals_expected:", data == b"p6-service-ok", "| len:", len(data))
PY
echo "=== access log from service (stderr) ==="
cat service.log
echo
echo "=== STOPPING service (pid $(cat service.pid)) ==="
kill "$(cat service.pid)"
for i in $(seq 1 20); do kill -0 "$(cat service.pid)" 2>/dev/null || break; sleep 0.2; done
if kill -0 "$(cat service.pid)" 2>/dev/null; then echo "still alive, SIGKILL"; kill -9 "$(cat service.pid)"; sleep 0.3; fi
echo "=== post-stop verification ==="
ps -p "$(cat service.pid)" -o pid,cmd || echo "process stopped: no such pid"
(ss -ltnp 2>/dev/null || netstat -ltn 2>/dev/null) | grep 8765 || echo "port 8765: no listener"
echo "=== curl after stop (expect connection failure) ==="
curl -sS --max-time 3 http://127.0.0.1:8765/health; echo "curl_exit=$?""}
